calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for noname
calls.summary: The discussion centered on Growth Book's shift from a free version to an enterprise pricing model for self-hosted clients. Maxim Knezevic from No Name Team detailed their budget of €11,250–€18,750 paired with needs for multi-organization support and access controls. James Shannon explained the new per-experiment pricing, which starts with a minimum contract of $30,000, emphasizing flexibility on included experiments. The contract approval process involves Maxim selecting the tool but requires finance sign-off. Recent tests have shown measurable revenue impacts, yet feature needs like SLA and access controls remain critical, while several UI bugs were acknowledged. Aiming for quick contract closure, James proposed a meeting to align on pricing and finalize details due to tight internal schedules.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Enterprise Pricing, Hyper-Casual Games, Experiment-Based Pricing, SLA, Budget Approval
